**Answer**

For every integer \(n\ge 2\) the induced Ramsey number \(r_{\mathrm{ind}}(K_{1,2},F_n)\) is unbounded; i.e. no finite graph forces a red induced \(K_{1,2}\) or a blue induced fan \(F_n\). Hence  

\[
\boxed{\displaystyle r_{\mathrm{ind}}(K_{1,2},F_n)=\infty\quad\text{for all }n\ge 2.}
\]
